JDT.method: Printed chapter endings, six combined labels and page continuations recorded separately in JDT-print-inventory.json; root checked final candidate against that source inventory after complete visual review and independent resolution of local glyph queries.

BAR.method: Independent reader inspected all printed margin labels, combined units and five page continuations in enlarged source images; root checked that separately recorded inventory against the finished word/point/punctuation review. Source record: BAR-print-inventory.json.

SUS.method: Read actual lower-body margins at enlarged resolution, separating combined labels from adjacent single labels. Read minimal neighboring text to establish the physical continuation when a label shares a row with the preceding unit ending. Headers, titles and commentary are not counted as units. Positional address40–41 is explicitly reconciled with the apparent source misprint in SUS-label-disposition.json, while the original independent inventory remains unchanged. Full point/word comparison is recorded in six SUS-page*-second-pass reports.

S3Y.method: Independent pre-transcription S3Y-print-inventory.json plus S3Y-final-closure-audit.json; four complete physical-page second-pass reports. Printed Septuagint source order and individual unreadable-mark dispositions checked. No OCR output is treated as approval.

LJE.method: Frenkel 1863 scan pages 113–116: every body word and readable point independently compared in two reviewer pairs; 79 printed sections and three page joins inventoried. Brenton Greek-English print pages 127–130 supplies an independently checked 73-unit target inventory. All 73 Hebrew target boundaries semantically compared after assembly; all source character spans conserved in order. One isolated unreadable dagesh is explicitly omitted with a source note. Hartom text, boundaries and approval were not used.
